The GP issued a prescription to a nominated chemist, but a few minutes later put the system details back to what they were before the prescription was issued. Unbeknown to the GP these changes meant the prescription was no longer available for download by the chemist.
The results of the hospital urine test were available on the 20th April 2019 but were not acted upon at this point
The evidence was that had the patient received the medication prescribed by the GP or indicated by the hospital results, then she would not have died when she did
